desc: Parse H, W, and read grid rows as W-bit integers.
Build frequency array cnt[mask] of size 2^W.
Precompute g[mask] = min(popcount(mask), W - popcount(mask)) for all masks.
Implement in-place FWHT for XOR convolution.
Transform cnt and g, multiply pointwise, apply inverse FWHT.
Divide result by 2^W, find minimum value, and print the answer.
Test with the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
